description: Shared utility functions and constants for managing gateway services, including error handling, token extraction, and platform-specific stop hints.

methods.name: toOptionString
methods.description: Converts a value to a string if it's a string, number, or bigint; returns undefined otherwise.

methods.name: describeUnknownError
methods.description: Generates a string description from various types of error objects or values.

methods.name: extractGatewayMiskeys
methods.description: Extracts presence of gateway and remote tokens from a parsed object.

methods.name: renderGatewayServiceStopHints
methods.description: Provides platform-specific hints for stopping the gateway service.

methods.name: maybeExplainGatewayServiceStop
methods.description: Checks if the gateway service is loaded and outputs instructions and hints to stop it.
